title: Understanding Accessible Lifting Equipment
summary: The Ministry of the Interior introduces accessible lifting devices designed to support people with mobility impairments in various settings.
body:
The Ministry of the Interior introduces accessible lifting devices designed to support people with mobility impairments in various settings.
